Belgium Apartment Building Fire Claims Multiple Lives

A massive fire engulfed a 10-story apartment building in Antwerp, Belgium, resulting in multiple deaths and injuries. The evacuation process was underway, with local residents advised to keep their windows and doors closed due to the smoke-filled air. The incident occurred in the Linkeroever district of the Belgian city.
